copy.tagline: 设计游戏化任务界面的三屏原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计带经验值系统的任务应用界面。
copy.tagline_en: Design a gamified three-screen task interface with XP and dark theme.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a task app interface with XP system and dark mode.

howto.what: 装上后，你可以让 Claude 生成一张游戏化习惯养成 App 的界面图，包含封面、今日任务（带 XP 和等级条）、任务详情三个手机屏幕，整体为暗色舞台风格。
howto.when: 当你要求设计一个游戏化习惯养成 App，或提到三屏手机界面、任务 XP 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个游戏化习惯 App 的三屏界面，暗色背景。
say.note: 会生成封面、今日任务和详情三个屏幕。

say.text: 设计今日任务页，带 XP 进度条和等级标签。
say.note: 显示任务列表和 XP 信息。

say.text: 做一个任务详情页，包含子任务和奖励。
say.note: 展示子任务清单与奖励内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to generate an interface image for a gamified habit app, including three phone screens: a cover, today's quests (with XP and level bar), and quest details, all in a dark showcase style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a gamified habit app design, or mention three-screen mobile UI, quest XP, or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Draw a three-screen gamified habit app UI with a dark background.
say_en.note: Generates cover, today's quests, and detail screens.

say_en.text: Design today's quests page with XP progress bar and level tag.
say_en.note: Shows quest list and XP info.

say_en.text: Make a quest detail page with subtasks and rewards.
say_en.note: Displays subtask list and reward content.
